real_db_readonly_smoke.projection_boundary_note: On the registry-backed mount only scope resolution is database-backed; the C9 facade query port is the deterministic closed-fixture _MemoryQueryReadPort (no_postgres_write=true). Evidence-matrix/ingest-registry projector reads are therefore not queryable as real registry-backed projections in the mounted wire path and are recorded as not wired, not as failed queries.

risks: All evidence is local; green business-chain suites are bounded evidence and do not establish provider attestation, canonical production write, cutover, authority transfer, or legacy retirement.

PG tests create and drop their own fixture-owned disposable databases (mrw_c7_movement_admission_test, mrw_c8_movement_closure_test, mrw_c9_movement_closure_test); these names are hardcoded in the test files and follow the existing PgEvidence convention rather than an explicit mrw_chainbatch_* name.
The real-db read-only smoke ran without legacy startup hooks and did not execute any production canonical write; counts before/after are unchanged.

The evidence-matrix/ingest-registry projection reads are not wired as registry-backed projectors in the mounted production_registry facade; only registry scope resolution is database-backed on that path.
